review.words: For all $n\ge 2k$ the least prime factor of $\binom{n}{k}$ is $\le\max(n/k,k)$, with only finitely many exceptions.

  ∀ (k : ℕ),
    K₃ < k →
      (↑k : ℝ) / (100 : ℝ) ≤
